title: Exact-partial c1 bounded RTL workload correspondence for Llama7B 131k
hypothesis: Bounded finalized-CDC RTL at window_count 1 through 4 can prove an affine startup and steady-state service recurrence, while explicit final-drain, tail, refill, persistent-state, and state-reuse checks make a 5462-window/head projection fail closed without brute-force full-layer RTL.

direct_comparison.primary_question: Do deterministic schedule counters and exact values match bounded real RTL for every divider width at 10 ns / 12 ns, and are the full-window service deltas affine before projection to 5462 windows/head and 32 heads/layer?
include: three full 24-token windows followed by one 8-token tail
two sequential heads reusing one temporal-state slot without reset
divider_lanes 1, 2, 4, and 8 at service_period_ns=10 and temporal_period_ns=12
affine-only projection to 5462 windows/head and serial 32-head/layer bounds
exclude: physical synthesis, place-and-route, or activity power
tail-cycle savings in the affine full-window projection
metrics: steady-state service cycles per additional full window
temporal final-drain cycles by divider lanes

required_evaluations.objective: Evaluate the checked-in bounded RTL correspondence report and its affine-only Llama7B projection.
required_evaluations.notes: Preparation only. Queue from merged origin/master; do not dispatch this branch.

remaining_abstractions_after_this_step: The recurrence proves bounded scheduling correspondence, not physical timing closure.
The serial layer bounds intentionally credit no head or layer overlap.
CDC MTBF and activity-backed energy remain separate signoff requirements.
